pairs.subject: tool-result-economy
pairs.evidence: crates/server/src/e2e/mcp.rs:117 The context's MCP tests drive pumper as a tool producer and read each tool's own result back as it was built. A search of crates/server/src/e2e/ for compress, elide, escape_hatch, summarize and tool_result found nothing. No transform sits between a tool and the model here: nothing compresses, summarizes or elides a result before an agent reads it, so the subject's precondition does not hold in this context.

techniques.evidence: crates/server/src/e2e/mcp.rs:456 The query_dataset result set reaches the caller whole, with its count. No size threshold or producer classification is applied to tool output in these tests or in what they exercise.

crates/server/src/e2e/mcp.rs:115 The tests only read the MCP envelope. The packaging is built off-context in crates/server/src/mcp/mod.rs:803-804, which puts the same payload in both content[0].text and structuredContent. That is a packaging question for the mcp context, not this test suite.

crates/server/src/e2e/mcp.rs:484 The only size reduction exercised is limit/offset paging, which the consumer chooses itself. The technique's 'when not to use it' section excludes reductions the consumer asked for, and no harness transform exists that would need a floor.
